mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 20 trading days compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 20 days, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over the prior 5 trading days signals accelerating labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 60 trading days indicate broad consumer demand contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline over prior 60 days, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings visibility and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 5 trading days indicates strengthening consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns as corporate revenue expectations improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS rises over prior 5 days, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 4.0% signals persistent price pressures, prompting restrictive monetary policy that depresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0% periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) over the prior 20 trading days indicate accelerating labor market deterioration, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns due to recessionary expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises over prior 20 days, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High interest rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) elevate equity discount rates and reduce risk appetite, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of FEDFUNDS > 5.0% periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
